alt: LUPPs brikker ligger i tre adskilte klynger på papiret. Kamæleonen og Raymond undersøger grupperingen ud fra brikkernes placering.

Raymond is the exact friendly blue elephant professor with large blue ears, swept tuft, bronze round spectacles, warm brown eyes, natural softly curled trunk, cream cable-knit cardigan over blue shirt and brown trousers, two true blue elephant hands. LUPP RIGHT of table looks down in curiosity, a little overturned plain wooden cup near him has spilled small game tokens onto a very large cream sheet laid FLAT covering most of the foreground. EXACTLY THREE OBVIOUS COMPACT SPATIALLY SEPARATED groups of small circular wood game tokens on this one2D paper area: one at lower left, one at upper center, one at lower right. Huge clean unoccupied space between these three clusters. Use the SAME plain pale honey-colored circular tokens in all3 groups, no labels, fruit symbols or preassigned category colors. Bird's-eye-enough angle to see distinct clusters but faces still close and expressive; tokens uniform size, no synthetic scatterplot UI, just actual woodpieces and pencil paper.
